meta_description: Commercial land clearing in Central Texas for owners, brokers and investors. Mulching, brush piles, survey lines and grounds upkeep from one family crew.
h1: Commercial land clearing for Texas properties that need to show well
lede: 9 Arrow Land Service provides commercial land clearing in Central Texas for owners, brokers and investors. We clear, mulch and maintain commercial property so buyers and tenants can walk it and see what it offers.

answer.q: What does commercial land clearing in Central Texas include?
answer.a: Commercial land clearing in Central Texas, as 9 Arrow Land Service does it, includes forestry mulching of brush and trees, selective clearing that keeps the best trees, mulching old brush piles, GPS-guided survey line clearing for acquisitions and ongoing grounds maintenance. The work leaves a fine mulch finish with no burn piles and no hauling.

highlights: Selective clearing keeps the best trees
Old brush piles mulched on site

sections.h2: Commercial land clearing that stages property
paras: Commercial property that sits overgrown hides its frontage, its topography and its best trees. 9 Arrow uses [land clearing](land-clearing) and forestry mulching to open sight lines and walkable ground, and selective clearing keeps the trees worth saving. Our own name for that work is staging property.

Forestry mulching grinds vegetation where it stands and leaves a fine finish that is easier to drive over. Under a light mulch, grass returns within days after rain. Mulching keeps the soil intact, which avoids the disturbed ground and erosion risk that come with dozing.
"John is one of the best in the business. 9 Arrow has cleared over a dozen properties for me, and every project has been handled with exceptional attention to detail." (Zach P., 5-star Google review)

sections.h2: Brush piles, debris and small structures on commercial land
paras: Many commercial tracts come with old bulldozer piles, some as large as a house, left from earlier clearing. 9 Arrow mulches existing brush piles on site through our [brush clearing](brush-removal) service, so there is nothing to burn. Burning is often prohibited during burn bans. Each pile is ground into the same fine mulch that covers the rest of the cleared ground.
9 Arrow grounds crews also handle debris and trash cleanup and light demolition of small structures on commercial property.

sections.h2: Survey lines for acquisition and pre-development
paras: Land acquisition and pre-development work often starts with seeing where the lines run. 9 Arrow's [survey line clearing](precision-line-survey-clearing) loads the licensed surveyor's CAD files onto Trimble receivers mounted on our mulchers. Our operators clear property lines, pad sites and future road locations from certified survey data with real-time GPS guidance, which reduces or eliminates pre-staking. 9 Arrow is not a licensed surveyor and works from your surveyor's data.

Cleared commercial land stays presentable with routine [grounds maintenance](grounds-maintenance). 9 Arrow mows, weed eats, trims trees selectively with chainsaws and cleans up debris on properties from small acreage to more than 1,000 acres. In the Texas growing season, monthly mowing is ideal, and every 2 to 3 months is the outer limit. One final mow usually carries a property through winter.

faqs.q: Does clearing commercial land increase its value?
faqs.a: Clearing commercial land can add value, because properly cleared and maintained land is healthier, more valuable and more enjoyable to own. Clearing opens sight lines and shows the topography, selective clearing keeps the best trees standing, and a fine mulch finish looks clean right away. Read more on [whether clearing increases property value](blog-does-clearing-increase-property-value).

faqs.q: Can 9 Arrow keep the trees on a commercial lot?
faqs.a: Yes. 9 Arrow offers selective clearing that removes brush and unwanted trees and leaves the ones you choose. Drought stress and oak wilt are common in Central Texas, and oak wilt spreads in defined paths. Infected trees cannot be restored, so selective clearing is often the best way to protect the healthy trees around them.

faqs.q: How is commercial land clearing priced?
faqs.a: 9 Arrow prices commercial land clearing after a discovery call, a site visit or both. The estimate depends on vegetation density, tree size and species, topography, access, maneuverability and soil conditions. We show the estimate by the day or by the acre, so you can see how the scope drives the number.
